data.name: Kunjbihari
data.long_meaning: Kunjbihari is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Kunja, meaning 'garden', and Bhari, meaning 'abounding' or 'filled'. This name signifies the one who is the lord of the garden of Lord Vishnu, in the form of a hare. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted as a hare with the sacred Tulasi plant in his hands, symbolizing purity, devotion, and protection.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of devotion and protection through Lord Vishnu.
